svg.title: Radxa CM5 ProComm iM2300 Top Panel Connector Layout Rev J
svg.desc: Dimensioned preliminary connector placement for a 431.8 by 298 millimeter Pelican iM2300 top panel, with a 15 millimeter four-side frame and screw keepout, left-to-right Gold Mount battery engagement, two diffused warm-white courtesy lights, one capacitive touch switch, no cooling openings, plus four Wi-Fi and four cellular RF bulkheads.
svg.text: RADXA CM5 PROCOMM - iM2300 TOP PANEL CONNECTOR LAYOUT
REV J CONCEPT | NO TOP-PANEL COOLING OPENINGS | 15 mm FRAME KEEPOUT | 4T4R WI-FI / EIGHT RF BULKHEADS
HINGE-EDGE LID HARNESS NOTCH - 90 x 8 PRELIMINARY

g.text: PANEL LIGHTS - DIFFUSED WARM WHITE / 12 V
Keep left insertion and release sweep clear
ENCLOSURE COOLING MOVED TO CASE SIDEWALLS

svg.text: PRELIMINARY PLACEMENT ONLY: replace every shown cutout with the final connector manufacturer's drawing and the measured iM2300 plate outline.
The top panel has no cooling openings. Sidewall fan cuts are controlled only by the separate Rev C cooling drawing and physical case measurements.
